free_tier.stated: No free allowance is stated on the pricing page read on 2026-11-18: the Provider plan starts at USD 15 a month plus a USD 1.01 processing fee, and pay-as-you-go starts with USD 15 of API credit and no monthly minimum.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: an inference endpoint stores nothing for the caller

egress.terms: the response is the payload; no separate egress term is published

tooling: the vendor CLI and its provider endpoint
chaining: the monthly plan plus a processing fee is the scarce link, and the fee is charged whether or not the month is used

limits.value: USD 15 of API credit to start, then top-ups, with no monthly minimum on the pay-as-you-go path

identity_cost.detail: the plan is billed monthly or topped up as credit
